# Trading Economics

> > Trading Economics provides comprehensive economic data, market indicators, and forecasts covering stock indices, government bonds, commodities, currencies, and energy markets worldwide.

The platform offers real-time quotes, historical charts, and analytical data for global financial markets, including specialized coverage of natural gas infrastructure, agricultural commodities, and emerging market securities. Data spans major economies and currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY, AUD) with particular focus on geopolitical impacts from regions like the Strait of Hormuz, Iran, Russia, and Ukraine.

## Key Topics

- Stock market indices and equity data
- Government bond yields (10-year benchmarks)
- Commodity prices (energy, agriculture, freight)
- Currency exchange rates and forex
- Natural gas storage and inventory (TWh, GWh/d)
- Historical market data and forecasts
- European Central Bank (ECB) policy
- Geopolitical risk factors (Iran, Russia, Ukraine, Strait of Hormuz)
- Energy market infrastructure
- Emerging market securities
- Credit ratings (Fitch, Moody's)
- Agricultural commodity trading
- Shipping and freight indices
- Gas Infrastructure Europe data
- Market volatility and crisis impacts

## Stock Market Indices

- [China Shanghai Composite Stock Market Index](https://tradingeconomics.com/china/stock-market): China Shanghai Composite index quotes, historical data & market analysis
- [Taiwan Stock Market Index (TWSE)](https://tradingeconomics.com/taiwan/stock-market): Taiwan TWSE/TAIEX stock index quotes with historical market data
- [Lithuania Stock Market Index (Vilnius)](https://tradingeconomics.com/lithuania/stock-market): Lithuania Vilnius stock index data, quotes, charts & forecasts
- [Ukraine Stock Market (PFTS)](https://tradingeconomics.com/ukraine/stock-market): Ukraine PFTS stock market index quotes, charts & historical performance
- [Laos Securities Exchange Composite Index](https://tradingeconomics.com/laos/stock-market): Laos LSX Composite stock index with Southeast Asia market data
